sheep.notes: herded_animal: starting gaia sheep and Pasture sheep (both herded_animal subtype, 200 food).

pasture_sheep.notes: Pasture sheep (gaia_herdable_sheep_mon) are herded_animal deposits, so they use the herded_animal slot; the separate gather_pasture slot (gather_target[11]) has no Mongol target found in the records.

farm.notes: Slot exists but Mongols have no Farm: racebps blueprint_archetypes.farm is empty and vps_farm is building_pasture_mon.

stone.notes: Mongol villagers cannot gather stone: the stone slot (gather_target[6]) is blanked (no sub type, rate 0, carry 0) and the villager carries ability villager_cannot_mine_stone_mon. Stone comes from Ovoos, the White Stupa, Stone Bounty and Stone Commerce.

cattle.notes: No Mongol cattle source; slot inherited.

evidence: raw:ebps/races/mongol/units/unit_villager_1_mon.json#default/resource_gatherer_ext/gather_types (12 slots read in order; slot [6] = stone blanked)
locale:11164707 (villager help text: Unable to gather Stone (build an Ovoo to gather Stone))

townCenter.notes: cost/buildSeconds are the extra Town Center (building_town_center_mon: 750 wood, 150 s, Feudal Age via requirement_ext feudal_age OR fast_expand). The capital starts packed (building_town_center_capital_moving_mon) and is deployed by the civ_start\Mongols state tree. Population comes from the 200 base cap, so a Town Center adds nothing usable. No Mongol villager-production multiplier was found in the TC, army or upgrade records; villagers train in the entity time (20 s). The TC also trains double villagers (unit_villager_1_double_mon) when inside Ovoo influence, see mechanics.double_production. Researches Textiles / Textiles (Improved).

ger.name: Ger
ger.notes: Mongol "house" archetype and also the lumber_camp and mill archetype (racebps). Drop-off for food, wood and gold; houses the economy technologies. Provides no usable population (Mongols start at the 200 cap). Packable: pack channel 10 s, unpack 8 s (statemodel). The game starts with one packed Ger.

pasture.name: Pasture
pasture.notes: Food building replacing Farms (racebps vps_farm). Spawns herdable sheep (herdable_sheep_mon, 200 food, herded_animal); not a drop-off itself. See mechanics.pasture.

ovoo.name: Ovoo
ovoo.notes: Must be placed on a stone outcrop (normal and _small variants: small deposits, footprint 6; _large: large deposits, footprint 8; same rates). Generates stone without villagers (see mechanics.ovoo_stone); constructing a new Ovoo destroys the prior one, hence limit 1. Source of Ovoo influence (district generator, range 8) that enables double production and Improved technologies. Hosts the Ovoo technologies.

stable.name: Stable
stable.notes: Available in the Dark Age (no age requirement; civ bonus "Stables available in the Dark Age"). Trains Early Horseman/Horseman, Keshik, Scout and their double variants.

archery-range.name: Archery Range
archery-range.notes: Trains Mangudai (horse archer) and, after Deer Stones, the Khan's Hunter, plus archers/crossbows/handcannons and double variants.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.notes: Blacksmith (melee/ranged damage and armor tiers, Military Academy, Biology).

market.name: Market
market.notes: Trader production; Stone Commerce. Mongols cannot buy or sell stone (allow_mongol_stone_market default false).

outpost.name: Outpost
outpost.notes: Yam aura: +15% move speed to nearby cavalry and Traders (mechanics.yam). Researches Yam Network.
evidence: raw:ebps/races/mongol/buildings/building_defense_outpost_mon.json#default/requirement_ext (only a rogue-mode bedrock_foundations any-list entry; treated as Dark Age)

arsenal.name: Arsenal
arsenal.notes: Hosts the Improved ranged damage/armor technologies (the Blacksmith only has the normal ones).

prayer-tent.name: Prayer Tent
prayer-tent.notes: Monastic Shrines lets Prayer Tents grant Improved Production within their influence without an Ovoo.

mechanics.summary: An Ovoo draws on the outcrop it stands on: placement requires a stone deposit with gatherable stone > 0 that is not already claimed, and the game has an "Ovoo is Depleted" state. Default deposit records hold 1200 (small) / 2400 (large); maps may override.
White Stupa (Imperial landmark): acts as an Ovoo with 240 stone/min without an outcrop and halves the stone cost of double unit production.

Producers inside Ovoo influence (or a Prayer Tent influence after Monastic Shrines; the TC for villagers) can queue a *_double_* item: same entity, number_to_spawn 2, with an item cost adjustment of -50% of one unit's normal resources and +stone. The *_double_* catalog records are these items, not separate units.

params.requires: producer within Ovoo influence (district range 8) / White Stupa / Prayer Tent with Monastic Shrines
params.costRule: chargedCostIfMultiplied = 2 x single unit cost + itemCostAdjustment (= 1.5 x single unit resources + stone per pair). Whether the engine multiplies squad cost by number_to_spawn is not decoded; the alternative (1 x cost + adjustment = 0.5 x for two units) is implausible.
params.timeRule: item uses the squad production time (same as one unit), giving 2 units per production cycle

mechanics.summary: Khan (horse archer) is a free start unit instead of a Scout, scales each age, respawns, and has Signal Arrows (maneuver +33% speed, attack speed +50%, armor +2). Note only.

Silk Road: Traders get extra resources by active trader count (+10% food at 5, +10% wood at 10, +10% gold at 15; with Stone Commerce +10%/+20% stone at 20). Silver Tree: trader production +40%, gold cost -40%. Note only (trade not modelled).
Raid Bounty: +25 food and +25 gold per enemy building ignited or destroyed under construction (Raid Bounty to 50, Improved to 75; Stone Bounty +50 stone, Improved +75).
Yam: Outposts (and the Deer Stones) give +15% move speed to nearby cavalry and Traders; Yam Network extends it to all non-siege units.
Horsemen train +25% faster: already baked into the Mongol horseman entity time (18 s vs 22.5 s elsewhere). Do not reapply.
Every Mongol building can pack into a mobile form (the *_moving_* catalog records) and redeploy. These are the same buildings, not extra building types.
